   235	def _conditional_entropy(tokens: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
   236	    """Mean plug-in H(T_l | T_<l), computed from this training minibatch."""
   237	    if tokens.shape[0] < 2 or tokens.shape[1] < 2:
   238	        return tokens.new_zeros((), dtype=torch.float32)
   239	    terms = []
   240	    for level in range(1, tokens.shape[1]):
   241	        prefixes, inverse = torch.unique(tokens[:, :level], dim=0, return_inverse=True)
   242	        h = tokens.new_zeros((), dtype=torch.float32)
   243	        for group in range(len(prefixes)):
   244	            values, counts = torch.unique(tokens[inverse == group, level], return_counts=True)
   245	            p = counts.float() / counts.sum().clamp_min(1)
   246	            h = h + (counts.sum().float() / len(tokens)) * (-(p * p.clamp_min(1e-12).log()).sum())
